name: Data Analyzer: With no proxy setting, a forged forwarding header cannot change the caller identity
objective: Proves a caller cannot pretend to be someone else by sending a made-up X-Forwarded-For header when no trusted proxy is configured.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key. The allowed number of wrong attempts is 3 within 60 seconds; counters are reset; the trusted-proxy setting (number of trusted forwarding hops) is unset. The test caller's own network address is 198.51.100.7 (a documentation-only address). No network and no AI model.

steps.action: Ask for the caller identity of requests that carry forged forwarding headers.
steps.expected: Both give the caller's real address 198.51.100.7.

name: Data Analyzer: With no proxy setting, changing the forwarding header does not escape a lockout
objective: Proves an attacker cannot reset their failure count by sending a different forged address on each attempt.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key. steps.action: Send 3 wrong-key requests, each with a different forged forwarding address.
steps.data: Keys w0 to w2, forwarded addresses 10.0.0.0 to 10.0.0.2

steps.action: Send a 4th wrong-key request with yet another forged address.

name: Data Analyzer: A forwarding header entry cannot inject odd characters into logs or storage

steps.expected: The caller's own address 198.51.100.7 is used.
